cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a desert oasis at golden hour — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a sunlit white marble temple — sitting on the ground; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — standing; a hotel suite with a city view and an open suitcase — holds her keepsake at chest height; a quiet spa lounge of robes — holds a book closed against her chest; a Yangtze ferry landing with moored junks under red sails and coiled ropes on the wooden pier — standing; a city rooftop with a water tank — standing; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — lying on her front; a domed marble hammam with warm stone slabs and brass bowls — sitting on the ground; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — raises a camera to her eye to take a photo; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — standing; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — carries her keepsake low at her side
